title: What's new in 1.1, and what's still in testing
body: A new launcher with automatic updates, proper 16:9 menus and HUD, mouse aiming, a clearer sniper scope and online play. Here's what's done and what's still being tested.

title: Online+ - a first look
body: Online+ is an optional second edition with its own lobby, server browser, ranks, killfeed and scoreboard. Everything sits in the game's own menus. The classic game and its multiplayer stay untouched.
